sections.Checks: Skip players who fail these checks. Each row is: Silent Aim, Aim Assist, Triggerbot.
sections.Y-Axis: Extra up/down aim adjustment. The three switches choose which features use it.
sections.Resolver: Use recent movement to help when a player's reported speed looks wrong.
sections.Anti-AimViewer: Put normal mouse aim back after the script sends a shot point.
sections.Client Bullets: Show your bullets going toward your mouse on YOUR screen. Keep the game's normal bullet style.
sections.Silent Aim: Help your shots aim at the chosen player.
sections.Aim Assist: Gently move your camera or mouse toward the chosen player.
sections.Triggerbot: Press shoot when an allowed player is under your mouse or inside your chosen shape.
sections.Whitelist: An empty list allows everyone. Assign someone to start filtering players.
sections.ESP: Show simple player boxes and names. There is no distance limit.
sections.2d-Box: Box looks and size. Boxes stay on the real player, are unfilled, and have solid outlines.
sections.Misc: Extra controls and small helper features.
sections.Gun Specifications: Give Silent Aim a different box size for each gun and distance. ESP shows that size too.
sections.Silent Aim/Prediction: Aim a little ahead of moving players. Auto chooses the time; Value is for manual prediction.
sections.Aim Assist/Prediction: Help the camera follow where a moving player is going.
sections.Triggerbot/Prediction: Use the player's expected next position for Triggerbot checks.
sections.Silent Aim/Target/Closest: Choose the body part or point nearest your mouse.
sections.Aim Assist/Target/Closest: Choose the body part or point nearest your mouse.
sections.Silent Aim/Toggle: Turn Silent Aim on or off with a button. Default: P.
sections.Silent Aim/Activation: Auto can run by itself. Target uses this button to pick or hold a player.
sections.Aim Assist/Toggle: Turn Aim Assist on or off. Default: M.
sections.Aim Assist/Activation: Default: hold Q while you want help aiming.
sections.Triggerbot/Toggle: Turn Triggerbot on or off. Default: V.
sections.Triggerbot/Activation: Default: hold the right mouse button to let Triggerbot shoot.
sections.Silent Aim/AntiCurve: Skip shot points that are too far from your normal aim line.
sections.Misc/Macro Abuse: Run the short macro shot sequence when its checks allow it.
sections.Misc/Panic: Stop the script and clean up its controls and drawings. Default: E.
sections.Misc/Prefire: Try a quick reply when the script detects an opponent firing. Default: hold C.

defaults.Enabled: Main on/off switch for this option.
defaults.Value: Starting time in seconds when Auto is false. Speed still adjusts it a little.
defaults.BasePart: Body part to use when Closest is off.
defaults.Raycast: Use the exact body surface under your mouse when available.
defaults.Selection: Part picks a part center. Point picks a point inside that part.
defaults.Axis: Center moves the point up/down. All lets it move in every direction.
defaults.Sharpness: 1 reacts right away. Smaller numbers move the point more slowly.
defaults.Center: 0 allows the edges. 1 keeps the point in the middle.
defaults.All: Same edge limit, used when Axis is All.
defaults.Visible: Show this shape on your screen.
defaults.Holding: True means keep the button held. False means press once where this control allows it.
defaults.Keybind: Keyboard key, mouse button, then which one to use: Keyboard or Mouse.
defaults.Unlock Method: Target only: Normal can unlock on the next press; Repeat picks again.
defaults.Players: Put Roblox user IDs in this list.
defaults.VisibleCheck: Only show players when there is a clear view.
defaults.Name: First value shows the name. Second chooses DisplayName, Name, or UserId.
defaults.Box: First color is the box. Second color is the outline.
defaults.AntiAfk: Help stop the game kicking you for standing idle.
defaults.AntiFling: Try to stop other players throwing you around.
defaults.Triggerbot check: Let Triggerbot shots start Macro Abuse too.
defaults.Macro Check: Only allow it when your recent movement is fast enough.
defaults.TargetOnly: Only let Triggerbot shoot Silent Aim's selected player.
defaults.Delay: How long to hold shoot after starting a shot, in seconds.
defaults.RandomDelay: Pick the hold time between these two numbers.
defaults.SmartDelay: Use Delay plus a little extra hold time for distant players.
defaults.DelayMethod: Normal uses Delay. Random uses RandomDelay.
defaults.Character: With FOV off: 1 is normal body size; 1.2 is 20% more mouse tolerance. The real body stays the same.
defaults.Follow: Camera moves your view. Mouse moves your mouse.
defaults.Smoothness: Smaller is gentler. Bigger catches up faster.
defaults.Ignore: Skip Silent Aim's FOV limit when true.
defaults.Offset: Custom only: upward lead. 1 is normal; 0.5 is less; 2 is more.
defaults.SilentAim: Let Silent Aim use this Y-Axis section.
defaults.Aim Assist: Let Aim Assist use this Y-Axis section.
defaults.Triggerbot: Let Triggerbot use this Y-Axis section.
defaults.Max: Allowed distance from the aim line in studs. math.huge removes this limit.
defaults.Radius: Allowed distance from the aim line in screen pixels. math.huge removes this limit.
defaults.WallCheck: Reject an aim point blocked by a wall.
defaults.GroundShotCheck: Keep downward aim lead above detected ground. Columns: Silent, Assist, Triggerbot.

paths.Silent Aim/Activation/Holding: Auto: true needs this button held; false runs by itself. Target: true holds the lock.
paths.Aim Assist/Activation/Holding: Auto: true needs this button held; false runs by itself. Target: true holds the lock.
paths.Triggerbot/Activation/Enabled: Use an activation button. False lets it run whenever Triggerbot is enabled.
paths.Triggerbot/Activation/Holding: True: hold the button to shoot. False: press it to switch shooting on/off.
paths.Checks/Wall: Skip aim points blocked by a wall.
paths.Y-Axis/Method: Auto handles up/down lead. Custom uses Offset.
paths.Silent Aim/Method: Auto keeps looking for a player. Target uses the player you pick.
paths.Aim Assist/Method: Auto keeps looking for a player. Target uses the player you pick.
paths.Silent Aim/Fov/Method: 2d-Box uses the player's box. 2d-Circle uses a circle around your mouse.
paths.Aim Assist/Fov/Method: 2d-Box uses the player's box. 2d-Circle uses a circle around your mouse.
paths.Triggerbot/Fov/Method: Choose 2d-Box or 2d-Circle when FOV is enabled.
paths.Triggerbot/Fov/Enabled: False checks the actual body with Character tolerance. True uses your chosen shape.
paths.Silent Aim/AntiCurve/Method: 3d-angles uses studs. Endmath uses screen pixels.
paths.Whitelist/Method: With names assigned: Friend skips them; Target only targets them. Empty allows everyone.
paths.Misc/Prefire/Range: Only Prefire's working range. ESP has no distance limit.
paths.Misc/Prefire/Delay: Wait this many seconds before the reply shot.
paths.Gun Specifications/Ranges/Close: Up to this distance uses Close.
paths.Gun Specifications/Ranges/Medium: Up to this distance uses Medium.
paths.Gun Specifications/Ranges/Far: Up to this distance uses Far. Beyond it uses the normal box.
